how_made: Watched by hand on 25 Oct 2026: 36 frames at 1 fps (640 wide), 1280x720 crops of the work area at 1 fps and 3 s steps. Sizes are rough, scaled from the gloved hand (palm about 90 mm across) and the Veggie root-mat frame. Times are +-1 s.
what_happens: An astronaut in a red shirt and blue gloves works at the Veggie plant-growth facility. On a blue bench sits an orange-framed baseplate holding six black plant pillows in two rows of three, each with a white fabric wick or seed opening on top. 0-12 s: both hands at the top-right pillow, tucking a strip of seed film into the pillow's seed opening. 13-31 s: the hands drop to the lower right and pull the next yellow-green seed-film strip out of a clear zip bag. 31-33 s: the hands carry the strip back up to the pillows. 33-36 s: the strip goes into the next pillow's opening (the clip ends mid-insert). Microgravity; no tools; one fixed camera.

rubric_truth.fixture: plant pillow (seed opening), one of six on a baseplate
known_misreadings: hard-drive units in a six-slot tray

spec.title: seed film into plant pillows
spec.summary: Tuck a strip of seed film into the seed opening of a plant pillow, take the next strip out of its bag, and tuck it into the next pillow.

warnings: the seed film is about 1 mm thick, under the 5 mm primitive floor
